$tagsComment: Tier 3 of docs/business-apps/architecture.md: the queue engine, which draws an app's queues/<id>.json (app-definition-v2.md, section 4). An engine is shared code, so it carries scope:shared as well as scope:engine, and imports only shared code and other engines.
